items.text: Day one of the US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi ended without announced agreements; [[p:Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] called it constructive, saying delegations discussed parameters for humanitarian steps, prisoner releases and the substance of long-term security guarantees. A second day opened on 11 Nov with a trilateral session, followed by Ukrainian meetings with French, German, British and Italian national security advisers.
items.notes: Outcome of day two not yet reported at time of logging. Watch item W-261025-04 (check date today).
